regional_strategy.evidence_limit: District-level statistics and adopted policies support strategic framing only. They do not establish site-level resident proportions, flows, preferences, consent, statutory controls, or project approval.

evidence_protocol.principle_zh: 证据不是背书，而是可推翻设计假设的输入。每条论文和现场数据都必须对应设计动作、适用边界和反证条件。

field_protocols.heritage_existing_condition: Distinguish opened Phase I, formally verified existing conditions, and new concept interventions before phasing or attribution.
field_protocols.metro_walk: Map accompanied real routes exit by exit and quadrant by quadrant; record crossing difficulty, detours, visible connectivity, and destination type.
field_protocols.microclimate: Use paired shaded/open controls at 1.5 m, one-minute summer readings from 07:00-19:00 plus PET/UTCI, winter wind, tree survival, materials, and maintenance.
field_protocols.older_adults: Pair objective audits with 10-15 minute perceived-neighbourhood surveys; separate physical activity from social interaction and include mobility-impaired and low-digital-literacy participants.
field_protocols.green_lifecycle: Track species diversity, survival, irrigation, maintenance cost, spatial equity, and annual adaptation rather than installed canopy alone.

spatial_status.interpretation: recalculable concept skeleton, not existing-condition GIS, statutory control, or engineering alignment

evidence_protocol.correction_rule: When public or field evidence contradicts a design assumption, preserve the evidence record, revise or withdraw the spatial move, rerun metrics and GeoJSON, and publish the change in changelog.md.
